logger.doc:name: initial Logger to add customer
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, message: "Initiating customer post request to PAPI" }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "firstName": payload.firstName, "lastName": payload.lastName, "gender": payload.gender, "address": payload.address.street, "city": payload.address.city, "state": payload.address.state }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Customer added successfully", new_customer: payload.data }

logger.doc:name: final logger post methd
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId default "N/A", httpMethod: vars.saveMethod default "POST", details: { message: "Customer successfully post into PAPI.", affected_rows: payload.affectedRows default 1, "data-updated": payload.new_customer } }]

logger.doc:name: set Logger to issues
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "log_type": "SYSTEM_API_ERROR", "API_NAME": app.name, "correlation_id": vars.correlationId, "flow_name": flow.name, httpMethod: attributes.method, "timestamp": now(), "details": { "target_id": attributes.uriParams.id default "UNKNOWN", "error_type": (error.errorType.namespace default "DB") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), "error_description": error.description default "No description available", "message": "Failed to "++ attributes.method ++ " customer from PAPI." } }]
